number.why: The reported primary 3-point MACE HR for linagliptin versus placebo is 1.02 (95% CI 0.89–1.17), with median follow-up of 2.2 years. Agreement includes the ruling's explicit qualification: this is a treated-set result; the served intention-to-treat label is not established.

quotes.span: Primary outcome was time to first occurrence of the composite of CV death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke.

During a median follow-up of 2.2 years, the primary outcome occurred in 434 of 3494 (12.4%) and 420 of 3485 (12.1%) in the linagliptin and placebo groups, respectively, (absolute incidence rate difference, 0.13 [95% CI, -0.63 to 0.90] per 100 person-years) (HR, 1.02; 95% CI, 0.89-1.17; P < .001 for noninferiority).

TIME FRAME: From randomization to individual end of observation; up to 4.3 years | POPULATION: Treated set (TS): All patients treated with at least one dose of trial medication. If no trial medication was taken at site during the visit, but the medication kit was dispensed to the patient and not all trial medication was returned, the patient was included in the TS.

entry.why: Adults with type 2 diabetes and elevated cardiovascular/renal risk satisfy the question's entry population. The packet also establishes a DPP-4 inhibitor, placebo comparator, randomization and double blinding. The analysis-set discrepancy does not negate entry eligibility.

quotes.span: among adults with type 2 diabetes, hemoglobin A1c of 6.5% to 10.0%, high CV risk (history of vascular disease and urine-albumin creatinine ratio [UACR] >200 mg/g), and high renal risk (reduced eGFR and micro- or macroalbuminuria).
To evaluate the effect of linagliptin, a selective DPP-4 inhibitor, on CV outcomes and kidney outcomes in patients with type 2 diabetes at high risk of CV and kidney events.
Patients were randomized to receive linagliptin, 5 mg once daily (n = 3494), or placebo once daily (n = 3485) added to usual care.
DESIGN: allocation RANDOMIZED | model PARALLEL | masking DOUBLE | who masked PARTICIPANT, INVESTIGATOR

missed: No additional finding changes either judgment. SERVED_CONFIRMED is defensible for the numerical estimate only with the ruling's existing treated-set qualification; it must not be interpreted as confirmation of the served intention-to-treat population.
